label: Every durable write in agent_substrate, its class, and whether it is decided under the writer lock. The writes, and how each is made, are measured by tools/authority_inventory.py; the class is a reviewed judgement.
rule: A DECISION or USE write is DECIDED -- written by append_decided, its decision taken under the writer lock against the history it is appended onto -- unless an OPEN finding in docs/security/findings.json names it. MINT, FACT and TELEMETRY writes permit nothing another writer's record could invalidate.

classes.DECISION: changes what someone may do, or what state a replay holds
classes.MINT: creates an entity under an identifier the writer generated at random

at_baseline_note: at_baseline is how the write was made at baseline_commit where that differs (APPEND: read-check-append outside the lock; ABSENT: no such record existed). Informational: the check measures the current tree only.

writes.why: a person's answer to an escalation is the authority a compensation or an override acts on; one answer per question
an exclusive claim on work; a second claimant would hold what the first was granted
opens the question a person's answer will authorize; one escalation per id
establishes a principal and its roles, which every later separation-of-duties check reads
withdraws a principal's standing; a retired principal's later answer is refused
a message between principals carries no authority; it is decided anyway because a reused message id is refused on replay
closes a question without an answer, which forecloses the answer
names the root issuer every grant's minting is checked against
a grant: what a subject may do, from where it is stamped
withdraws a grant for every later check
what was in front of a run, by digest; folded by no reducer and permits nothing
names who ran the task, which separation of duties is checked against; decided against the head and the lease it ran under
content digests of what the tool produced; the verdict re-derives them from disk rather than trusting this record
a task's lifecycle move, re-authorized on replay
how a result was checked; the verdict it supports is its own decided transition, and a stale record is flagged by the second reader
what a separate process concluded about the log; the verdict is the decided transition after it
the outcome of an undo whose authorization was already consumed under the lock by task.compensation.authorize; replay accepts one outcome per authorization, citing it
consumes a person's COMPENSATE answer before an external undo runs; one answer authorizes one undo
creates a task under an id this writer draws from uuid4; no other writer's record can name it first, and admission was decided by the policy decision recorded before it
binds a request key to one task; a rebinding would suppress the work it named
retracts or supersedes a memory, which changes what recall returns
claims a memory id once; a second write to it would silently replace the first
an egress grant
an egress request allowed or refused, counted against a quota; re-decided under the lock so a spent budget or a revoked grant is honoured
the outcome of a request whose authorization was already recorded; folded into no decision
a service contract and its quota, which every egress decision reads
withdraws an egress grant
a policy verdict, re-evaluated on replay
a policy version
withdraws a policy
fixes the history's authentication profile, once, at its start
receipt of a NON_AUTHORITATIVE proposal; decided because two receipts of one id would be refused on replay
a REFUSED read: an attempt, which permits nothing
an allowed read under a capability, decided against the grants in force at the head it is written onto
admits a job to the queue
extends a worker's lease
reorders the queue
a job's lifecycle move, dispatch and outcome included
a secret revealed under a grant; decided and recorded under the lock before the value is returned
a secret grant
binds a secret id to one provider; a second source for one id is refused
withdraws a secret grant
a dependency between records, which the invalidation cascade follows
binds the store to the policies its promotions are checked against
the digest of a projection at a position, which authorizes restoring from a snapshot
a scientific record
a record's authority move: VERIFIED, PROMOTED, REVOKED
